'''Usk Haffa''' was a [[Bivall/Legends|Bivall]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] property magnate who was the largest real-estate owner on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Protobranch/Legends|Protobranch]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point, Haffa accompanied the [[Luxury liner/Legends|liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'' on a luxury cruise. During the voyage, the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] attempted to kidnap several high-profile passengers aboard the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], by staging an explosion aboard the ship and then trying to deceive his targets into accompanying him into an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. However, Haffa and the [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] entrepreneur [[Sibs Monchan]] refused to enter the pod, believing that it would be safer to remain aboard the liner.
